svg.title: Five records, bounded observation points
svg.desc: A scope matrix separates legal process, OpenAI's company report, Hugging Face host telemetry, the METR and Redwood investigation, and vendor remediation. Concise visual labels map to fuller source and engagement boundaries in the evidence notes. The five evidence lanes answer different questions and carry different access, support, editorial-control, payment, and attribution boundaries.

g.aria-label: Access, HF telemetry: Host systems. Verified.
Access, METR + Redwood: Host-controlled access. Caution.
Access, Legal process: Compulsory requests. Caution.
Access, OpenAI report: First-party systems. Caution.
Access, Vendor record: Published records. Caution.
